summary:
Reviewed w165, one commit (34ee952c; the same code as the reported 6a4244bb, re-applied by the merge).
`work request --delegation` writes a JSON-quoted `delegation` frontmatter field in the same commit, and writes no field when the option is not given, as r19 and the Implementation section ask.
No test removed or weakened and nothing under features/ changed. The plan lists no broken tests and the report claims no allowances.
ruff passes. vulture's one hit (requests_write_steps.py:76 'named') was already there before the commit. size prints nothing. The r19 scenario passes.
Three Minor findings: a missing space (drop); an empty --delegation is stored but read as none (observation); model_parse does not unescape quoted values (observation).
